milestones.name: Obtain Shade Cloak
milestones.note: Acquired in the Abyss at the bottom of Ancient Basin after activating the lighthouse

milestones.name: Activate Lighthouse
milestones.note: Lever at the top of the void siblings platforming section turns on the lighthouse, eliminating void liquid

milestones.name: Obtain King's Brand
milestones.note: Required prerequisite before entering the Shade Cloak area via the door at the bottom of Ancient Basin

zones.name: Ancient Basin
zones.fingerprintHint: Dark, gothic stone architecture, spiked hazards, bottom of the map

zones.name: The Abyss
zones.fingerprintHint: Pitch black void, void liquid/sibling entities, lighthouse structure, dark rocky platforms with moss/growths
zones.note: Accessed from Ancient Basin via a door opened with King's Brand

zones.name: Abyss Lighthouse
zones.fingerprintHint: Top of platforming section inside the Abyss, contains soul and a lever

zones.name: Shade Cloak Chamber
zones.fingerprintHint: Right side of the falling void liquid room in the Abyss, contains Shade Cloak and an Arcane Egg

abilities.name: Shade Cloak
abilities.grants: Invulnerability during a dash; required to pass through Shade Gates including the one splitting the two sections of Fog Canyon
abilities.note: Upgraded version of Mothwing Cloak. Cooldown is slightly longer than a normal dash, allowing two normal dashes between each Shade Cloak dash. Prerequisites: Mothwing Cloak, Mantis Claw, Monarch Wings, King's Brand.

abilities.name: Mothwing Cloak
abilities.note: Required prerequisite for obtaining Shade Cloak

abilities.name: Mantis Claw
abilities.note: Required prerequisite for obtaining Shade Cloak

abilities.name: Monarch Wings
abilities.note: Required prerequisite for obtaining Shade Cloak

abilities.name: King's Brand
abilities.note: Required to open the door at the bottom of Ancient Basin leading to the Abyss and Shade Cloak

objectives.name: Open the door at the bottom of Ancient Basin
objectives.hopDescription: Use King's Brand to open the door at the very bottom of Ancient Basin
objectives.note: King's Brand must already be in possession

objectives.name: Navigate down and right through the Abyss
objectives.hopDescription: Drop down past spikes and void shadow entities, then go right past platforms

objectives.name: Climb the void siblings platforming section
objectives.hopDescription: Make your way up platforms while avoiding siblings (deal 2 damage on hit, do not grant Soul when struck)

objectives.name: Activate the Lighthouse lever
objectives.hopDescription: Reach the top of the platforming section and pull the lever to turn on the lighthouse, eliminating void liquid

objectives.name: Cross the void liquid and reach the Shade Cloak
objectives.hopDescription: Crystal Dash or swim across the now-eliminated void liquid area and go to the right side of the falling room to acquire Shade Cloak and an Arcane Egg

connectors.description: Door at the very bottom of Ancient Basin, opened with King's Brand
Platforming section upward through void siblings leads to lighthouse canopy at the top
Right side of the falling void liquid room, accessible after lighthouse is activated to eliminate void liquid
connectors.note: Crystal Dash or swimming can be used to cross
